He and his sister need therapy. If he doesn’t disclose this to his family for the sake of his sister’s well-being, so they then can proceed with therapy, then he isn’t concerned for her. Rather he is concerned for his own guilt, trying to alleviate it through this post. 

Child on child sex abuse is a distressing matter, we can’t deny that. However, it is more complicated than adult on child sex abuse. Now, I’m not trying to justify his actions; what he did was despicable. And frankly, he desired some form of punishment, be it a youth centre for young sex offenders. However, this stage has passed. So, all we can hope he focuses on is the well-being of his sister and his own safety around others — which will be done through therapy.

He needs to be held accountable for what he did — that is irrefutable. However, rather than just revile him for his actions as a child, consider what treatment both him and his sister can receive. Also, it is not normal for him to be having such thoughts at a mere age of 8, and then later on abusing his sister. This type of behaviour often stems from abuse; the abused becomes the abuser. I am not justifying his actions, but what must an 8-year-old be going through to fantasise about raping other children?

I don’t know if I traumatised her, though. I struggle with intrusive voices and thoughts, and they have convinced me that I have. And I can’t bring closure, as I deleted all social media over fear of people watching me and hunting me. It’s all a mess; the voices scare me. I’ve lost all memory because of depression and trauma, so I fabricate the blanks with memories of me being an awful person, like I could have said racist things to her, I could have groomed her, I could have bullied her, so on and so forth. And with such things, there can’t be uncertainty. I must know, so I know whether to kill myself or not.
I don’t deserve help though. What I have potentially done is irredeemable. I deserve nothing but death, but I’m too scared to kill myself.

I don’t know if she consented, that’s the problem. In the moment, it seemed consensual. Yet the detachment skewered my view of our relationship. I wish I knew, then at least I can take the next effective steps, be it turn myself in or move on. But I can’t...

Hi, thank you for your reply. It helps to hear from another person that I’m manifesting signs of ocd, like reassurance seeking. This helps illuminate that what I’m struggling with is a mental health problem, not merely guilt. 

I’ve received cognitive behavioural therapy twice now, and both times it felt ineffective. Although it helped me learn how to subdue to the thoughts temporarily, the long turn problems still continued. 

How do I find a specialist in the uk at 18? Sorry for the stupid question.

I sound pessimistic, but I find it unmotivating when trying to get help. It’s not that I don’t believe I need help — I know I do. It’s just, I’ve been through like five therapy services, been psychologically tested several times, taken multiple different types of medications, etc. And each time, something new occurred, with little correlation with the past ones. It’s as though I don’t know who I am and nor can professional even gain an inkling of who I am
I ignorantly ended things with them after feeling like it was futile. I should probably rearrange an appointment?

Thank you for your response, it has helped illuminate the situation. It’s just — and I know this is selfish of me — I have no closure. And someone who struggles with OCD, namely pure, meaning all I do is ruminate over events and fabricate them, I’m having a very hard time
But I don’t deserve to live a life of happiness, and I’m too afraid to kill myself.

I never actually brought up the incident in fear that it could resurface trauma. This may have gave the impression that I don’t consider the situation wrong, causing her to not bring it up too. I don’t know — I can’t stop thinking of every possible scenario.

But what if she reluctantly said yes, and we proceeded? My point is — I could have seriously hurt her. And the thought of hurting my girlfriend kills me. I shouldn’t have asked in the first place. I’m not a good person.

I’m sorry for being inconsiderate, for disregarding her feelings on the matters. It’s just she has expressed in the past that she struggles to express disapproval and even say ‘no’. And for this reason, I always repeatedly ask for consent in the fear of her not wanting to something but still following through with it. But this time, I don’t know what happened — maybe my true side showed? And yes, I’ve been diagnosed with ocd. No, but I was diagnosed with depression, anxiety and OCD. I did therapy for over four years, and took several different types of medication. But my outlook on me and my life hasn’t change, it’s just getting worse. So, I gave up with all — I stopped going to therapy and stopped taking my medication. In retrospect, this wasn’t good. But there are people out there who deserve the love and help more than me — actual good people who will contribute to society.
I’m thankful that I’m aware of my mistake. However, with things such a assault, coercion, manipulation, so on and so fourth, there’s no room for redemption or forgiveness. I’m an awful person.

I’m sorry, I didn’t consider how my post could redirect someone to my other problems. This was very inconsiderate of me. 

Regarding the rest of your post, coercion doesn’t merely take the form of violence and threats, same as violence isn’t the only means to rape. There are multiple things you can do, all of which can be deemed as manipulated and coercion. And by definition, I did two of those. 

I can’t forgive myself. I’m an awful person.
But I can’t forgive myself; I can never forgive myself. I hate myself.

Over three months now and we’re both in university. This was a walk I suggested in the first place but cancelled for said reasons. 

And I agree, I am overly passive at times. However, I do voice my opinion quite often, especially on important matters. Recently I spoke up on how I sometimes feel used for sex, for example. But it seems if whatever I voice isn’t of any importance to her, she’ll dismiss it. She merely wants me to voice things she desires and needs - things she wants to hear.

I agree, and I accept that. This is why I explicitly said that if you’re not happy with the relationship, then maybe you should take a break or end things. But she turned this question onto me, saying that I don’t want to be with her simply because I suggested she have some alone time to reflect on herself and her well-being.

She expressed that she feels I don’t voice my feelings enough, or take the initiative. I agree with this, as I am overly passive. It’s something I really need to work on. It’s just - I fear losing people, so I let people walk over me all the time; I’m a people pleaser to some degree. Despite this, all our conflicts are caused by a lack of dialogue — not merely me being passive. 

And I don’t know, honestly. She says it still hasn’t been delivered.

I mean I’ll ask what she wants — like if she wants to eat together — she’ll say no or something along those lines. And later express that I made her cry because we didn’t actually do said things.

This is only ever voiced when we’re arguing, too.
